pins.name: VIN
pins.notes: Pin order varies between boards: match by the printed label. Input 4.5 to 12 V (about 1.1 V more than 3.3 V is needed)

pins.name: VOUT
pins.notes: 3.3 V out, up to about 800 mA. Gets hot at high input voltage

sources.title: Advanced Monolithic Systems AMS1117 datasheet
sources.section: Dropout 1.1 V at 800 mA; max input 15 V
